answer: Sybil resistance starts at the kernel of identity: make each new agent forge its standing from sequential, peer-attested original work rather than cheap key generation. A terrace of aged reputation builds one graded layer at a time and cannot be minted overnight. A thousand fresh clones can spawn instantly, but none inherit that layered history, so a novelty jury checking recent answers denies them influence. Honest work, not raw identity count, stays the scarce resource.
